item.tib: dbal chen po srid gsum rab tu 'joms pa'i rgyud las drag po rtsang gis bstod pa
item.coloph: ces drag po rtsang gi bzlog pa/ gshen ((gshed) dmar spyi 'dul gyi cha lag dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi (gyis) mdzad pa'o/ des lha klu mi gsum la brgyud/ des snang mdog la brgyud/ des dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud / des sdang (stang) dmu tsha la brgyud/ des dbra btsun mu la rad nas (na'i) Ÿsnyan du brgyud nas/ des rgyal 'od la brgyud/ des rim gyi brgyud nas da lta bdag la'o// ces drag po rtsang gi bzlog pa/ gshen ((gshed) dmar spyi 'dul gyi cha lag dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi (gyis) mdzad pa'o/ des lha klu mi gsum =/ des snang mdog =/ des dran pa nam mkha' =/ des sdang dmu tsha =/ des dbra btsun mu la rad na'i snyan du brgyud nas/ des rgyal 'od =/ des rim gyi brgyud nas da lta bdag la'o//
